active_buff_blue.purpose: Check whether blue enhanced gathering buff is already active on map.

active_buff_purple.purpose: Check whether purple enhanced gathering buff is already active on map.

item_blue.purpose: Find blue enhanced gathering item in Items > Boosts.

item_purple.purpose: Find purple enhanced gathering item in Items > Boosts.

action_order: Check active blue buff image on current screen.
Check active purple buff image on current screen.
If either buff is active, do nothing.
Try to find and use blue gathering item.
If blue item is not found, try to find and use purple gathering item.
notes: The original project does not read item text or stats. It only compares images and taps fixed coordinates.
The original file_relative_paths.py maps ENHANCED_GATHER_PURPLE item to the blue item image. This export maps purple to images/items/enhanced_gathering_purple.png.
